description: This file defines the 'Topic' model class for the OpenCart CMS, handling database interactions related to topics such as retrieving individual topics, lists of topics, and layout IDs.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Model class for handling database operations related to topics in the OpenCart CMS.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves a specific topic record by its ID, utilizing caching to optimize repeated fetches.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active topics, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific topic.
